_description: Defines gradient styles and colors for screenshot backgrounds, and final canvas sizes for App Store

iphone_17_pro_max_portrait._comment: iPhone 17 Pro Max App Store requirement

ipad_pro_13-inch_(m5)_portrait._comment: iPad Pro 12.9" equivalent - Fastlane requires 2048x2732 (resized from 2064x2752 capture)

light._comment: Blue gradient for light mode screenshots

dark._comment: Dark purple gradient for dark mode screenshots

light._comment: Blue mesh gradient for light mode - smooth 4-corner interpolation

dark._comment: Dark purple mesh gradient for dark mode - smooth 4-corner interpolation

_notes: canvas_sizes: per device/orientation canvas width/height (pixels); Step 3 resizes layers to fit these.
layout_defaults: fallback text_box + layer definitions per orientation (used when story layout omits them).
text_box.start/height: fractions of canvas height; Step 4 uses the same values to position text overlays.
Layers accept type (screenshot/asset), width (fraction of canvas width), rotation (degrees), anchor, and offsets (0..1).
styles.gradients/styles.mesh define theme color palettes and text_color (Step 4 uses text_color for contrast).
